description: Marble Shields: Firefox-backed per-site switches for the Marble shields panel.

functions.name: setFingerprinting
functions.description: Turns fingerprinting protection on or off for a hostname's site.

functions.name: setForgetMe
functions.description: Clear the site's data when its last tab is closed.

functions.name: closePanel
functions.description: Closes the shields panel in the current browser window.
